method: Gaussian-process surrogate (ARD Matern 5/2 + white noise, sklearn) fitted on the 64 Sobol-type experiments; first-order indices by Saltelli (2010) and total-order indices by Jansen (1999) pick-freeze estimators evaluated on the surrogate with N=200000 Monte Carlo samples. Surrogate check: 8-fold CV R^2=0.960, RMSE=0.327 (std of y = 1.630). The reviewer's pick-freeze design needs 63 runs and could not be applied to the mandated 64-point Sobol design. Indices are only as accurate as the surrogate.
